brief: Compare two work arrangements using stated net income, time and necessary costs.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Compare the whole arrangement"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Compara el acuerdo completo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Compare o acordo inteiro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare two work arrangements using stated net income, time and necessary costs.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare work using received pay, required costs and time together.
instruction.misconception: Choose the larger headline payment without accounting for costs or time constraints.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A shift pays 100 dollars minus 30 travel: 70 remains. Another pays 85 without costs, leaving more.
A leaves seventy; B leaves eighty under these terms.
Equal pay can come with unequal time commitments.
The care constraint limits which offer is feasible.
Different pay periods require a common time basis.
An unknown necessary cost can change the comparison.
Remote leaves one hundred thirty; onsite leaves one hundred twenty.

en-US.line: Compare work using received pay, required costs and time together.

en-US.line: A shift pays 100 dollars minus 30 travel: 70 remains. Another pays 85 without costs, leaving more.

es-MX.line: Un turno paga 100 pesos con 30 de viaje; otro paga 85 sin viaje. Después de costos quedan 70 y 85.

pt-BR.line: Um turno paga 100 reais com 30 de viagem; outro paga 85 sem viagem. Após custos sobram 70 e 85.

en-US.prompt: Which leaves more after stated costs?
en-US.scene: Same hours: A pays 90 after deductions with 20 travel; B pays 80 with no costs.
help: Compare after-cost amounts for the same hours.

feedback.met: A leaves seventy; B leaves eighty under these terms.
feedback.not_yet: Compare after-cost amounts for the same hours.

es-MX.scene: Mismas horas: A paga 90 netos con viaje de 20; B paga 80 sin costos.
help: Compara montos tras costos para horas iguales.

feedback.met: A deja setenta; B deja ochenta bajo estas condiciones.
feedback.not_yet: Compara montos tras costos para horas iguales.

pt-BR.prompt: Qual deixa mais após custos informados?
pt-BR.scene: Mesmas horas: A paga 90 líquidos com viagem de 20; B paga 80 sem custos.
help: Compare valores após custos para horas iguais.

feedback.met: A deixa setenta; B deixa oitenta sob essas condições.
feedback.not_yet: Compare valores após custos para horas iguais.

en-US.scene: Two offers have equal after-cost pay but require different hours.
help: Keep time and money visible together.

feedback.met: Equal pay can come with unequal time commitments.
feedback.not_yet: Keep time and money visible together.

es-MX.scene: Dos ofertas dejan igual pago tras costos, pero requieren horas distintas.

pt-BR.scene: Duas ofertas deixam pagamento igual após custos, mas exigem horas diferentes.
help: Mantenha tempo e dinheiro visíveis juntos.

feedback.met: Pagamento igual pode exigir tempos diferentes.
feedback.not_yet: Mantenha tempo e dinheiro visíveis juntos.

en-US.prompt: Which leaves more under these terms?
